title: Use dynamic tables for near-real-time Silver
context: Warehouse task data must reach Silver within 30 minutes; dbt runs every hour today.
options:
dbt incremental every 15 minutes
Streams + tasks with MERGE
Dynamic tables with TARGET_LAG = 30 minutes
consequences:
Less orchestration code
Refresh cost visible in DYNAMIC_TABLE_REFRESH_HISTORY
Complex non-deterministic logic stays in dbt
